# moodle_group (Resource)

Creates a group in a Moodle course.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "moodle_group" "team_one" {
  course_id     = moodle_course.example.id
  name          = "Team One"
  description   = "<p>First project group.</p>"
  enrolmentkey  = ""
  visibility    = 0
  participation = 1
  idnumber      = ""
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `course_id` (Number) The ID of the course in which the group is created.
- `name` (String) The name of the group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the group (HTML supported).
- `enrolmentkey` (String, Sensitive) Enrolment key for the group. Empty means no key.
- `idnumber` (String) An optional ID number for the group.
- `participation` (Number) Whether the group is a participation group. 1=yes, 0=no. Default: 1.
- `visibility` (Number) Visibility: 0=all members, 1=not in group, 2=only members, 3=none. Default: 0.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the created group.
